# Trazo field boundary annotations for South America with splits

Trazo with splits field boundaries (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from World Resources Institute and Arizona State University. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/wri_trazo_ml/latest/wri_trazo_ml.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/wri_trazo_ml/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: id, geometry, determination:datetime, region, basemap, split, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/wri_trazo_ml/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/wri_trazo_ml/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/wri_trazo_ml/collection.json
